blocks.text: LONDON, United Kingdom — After months of speculation, British actor Robert Pattinson was named Monday as the new James Bond, taking on the coveted role of the world’s most famous fictional spy. “Amazon MGM Studios has announced that Robert Pattinson will take on the iconic role of James Bond,” the studio said. Pattinson, 40, will succeed Daniel Craig as the suave MI6 agent, “ushering in a new era for one of cinema’s most celebrated characters,” the studio added.
